name: Synthetic service agreement example
source: Synthetic contract fixture for renderer tests; no real provider approval

clauses.LOE_ACCEPTANCE: On delivery of the work described above, the engagement is complete and the deliverable is accepted. Any factual correction is raised in writing within five (5) business days and Service Provider will correct factual errors.

CLIENT_RESOURCES_ASSESS.responsibility: Own the business questions the assessment answers. Approve the in-scope areas, attend the executive readout, and act on the recommendations.
Client-side point of contact for the Service Provider team. Schedule stakeholder sessions, coordinate access, and confirm attendee availability.
Participate in discovery and working sessions for the in-scope areas. Provide the context, current-state detail, and priorities the assessment depends on.
Provide read access to the relevant systems and answer technical and data questions. Participate in the technical and data portions of the assessment.
CLIENT_RESOURCES_ASSESS.commitment: As scheduled, higher during the assessment stage

clauses.CLIENT_RESOURCES_NOTE_ASSESS: A person can hold more than one role. Time commitments are the availability the assessment depends on and are confirmed at kickoff.
clauses.PROJECT_MANAGEMENT_INTRO_ASSESS: The assessment lead coordinates the work and presents the findings. The lead will:
PROJECT_MANAGEMENT_BULLETS_ASSESS: Schedule discovery and working sessions with the appropriate Client personnel
Provide status updates against the assessment stages
Maintain a running log of findings, open questions, and information gaps
Prepare and deliver the executive readout
clauses.CLIENT_RESOURCES_INTRO_ASSESS: The assessment requires the Client participation listed below. Time needed depends on the stakeholders and systems in scope, and on access to current process information. Confirm each person’s availability at kickoff.
clauses.PREAMBLE: This Statement of Work (“SOW”) is a contract, entered into on the Effective Date of this SOW, by and between {PROVIDER} (“Service Provider”, “we”, “us”, or “our”) and {CLIENT} (“Client”, “you”, or “your”), together with its subsidiaries and affiliates (“{CLIENT}”). This SOW is subject to the terms and conditions stated herein and the terms and conditions set forth in that certain Professional Services Agreement executed by Service Provider and Client effective as of the date stated below (the “Agreement”). The Agreement is hereby incorporated into this SOW by reference as though fully set forth herein. Capitalized terms used in this SOW shall have the meanings defined herein or as used in the Agreement.
clauses.NOTICE_SP_LABEL: Name and Notice Address of Service Provider
clauses.NOTICE_CLIENT_LABEL: Name and Notice Address of Client
clauses.PROJECT_SCOPE_INTRO: Service Provider will provide services subject to the terms of this SOW and the Agreement (the “Services”). The Services are based on the following assumptions, representations and/or information supplied by you.
clauses.OUT_OF_SCOPE_HEADER: For the sake of clarity, the following Activities are out of scope:
clauses.ELAPSED_PERIOD: The Services pursuant to this SOW are estimated to be performed over an elapsed period of “{N}” weeks based on the timeline below.
clauses.PROJECT_MANAGEMENT_INTRO: Service Provider will manage the project through the following activities:
PROJECT_MANAGEMENT_BULLETS: Ongoing management of the plan as activities move or adjust
Schedule design and validation workshops with appropriate Client personnel
Perform day-to-day project management and change control
Provide weekly status reports and updates to the project team
Manage the risk and issue log, complete with action items, due dates, and mitigation plan
Conduct weekly status meetings (30 minutes) to discuss the status report, issues, and risks
clauses.CLIENT_RELIANCE: You will designate an employee or employees who will make or obtain all management decisions with respect to this engagement on a timely basis. You also agree to ensure that all assumptions set forth below are accurate and to provide us with such further information we may need and which we can rely on to be accurate and complete. You also agree to cause all levels of your employees and contractors to cooperate fully and timely with us. We will be entitled to rely on all of your decisions and approvals made independently and we will not be obligated to evaluate, advise on, confirm, or reject such decisions and approvals.
clauses.CLIENT_RESOURCES_INTRO: The service-intake pilot requires the Client roles below to provide requirements, arrange access, and review the configured workflow. These availability estimates apply to this four-week pilot.

CLIENT_RESOURCES.responsibility: Approve the pilot requirements and acceptance record; resolve scope questions.
Provide the intake examples, review the configured workflow, and execute the acceptance cases.
CLIENT_RESOURCES.commitment: 4 hours per week; 8 hours during validation

CLIENT_RESOURCES.responsibility: Provide access to the selected service platform and support configuration review.

clauses.CLIENT_RESOURCES_NOTE: A resource can have multiple roles. Actual time commitments are confirmed per engagement and may be adjusted in scoping.
clauses.COMMENCEMENT_STAFFING: The Project shall commence no earlier than thirty (30) calendar days following the date of last signature on this Statement of Work (the “Effective Date”). The specific kickoff date will be confirmed upon resource assignment. Service Provider reserves the right to determine the specific individuals assigned based on availability, skill set, and project requirements.
clauses.COMMENCEMENT_STAFFING_ASSESS: The assessment will commence within a mutually agreed window following the date of last signature on this Statement of Work (the “Effective Date”), and the specific kickoff date will be confirmed upon resource assignment. Service Provider reserves the right to determine the specific individuals assigned based on availability, skill set, and project requirements.
PROTECTIVE_ASSUMPTIONS: Timelines, duration of Project and resources, etc. are based on timely execution of this SOW, and as applicable, the Agreement.

Client will ensure: (i) that executives, management and key application owners (both business & technical), operations, and infrastructure resources of both Client and all third party vendors will be reasonably and timely available as required by Service Provider, for interviews, meetings, and knowledge transfer; (ii) that both Client and all third party vendors will timely provide documentation; (iii) that all third party vendors meaningfully participate as required by Service Provider for the performance of this SOW; and (iv) that qualified individuals from Client and all third party vendors are made reasonably available as required and perform their assigned tasks and responsibilities in a timely manner.

Client will make timely decisions and obtain required management approvals, all consents, and/or licenses necessary from third parties required for Service Provider to perform its obligations outlined in this document.
Client will retain responsibility for its compliance with all applicable federal, state/provincial and local laws and regulations.

Service Provider will be entitled to rely on all Client decisions and approvals made in relation to this SOW. Although nothing in the SOW will require Service Provider to evaluate, advise on, modify, confirm, or reject such decisions and approvals, Service Provider will use its knowledge and expertise to guide client where appropriate.
Service Provider cannot provide assurance against all possible security vulnerabilities (even where the scope of the engagement involves identifying security vulnerabilities).

Additional time to conduct workshops required to accurately define business processes and requirements for the capabilities defined in this SOW may require a Change Order to be reviewed and executed by Service Provider and Client.

If changes to the SOW are identified and/or requested by Client or Service Provider during the course of the Project, a Change Order will be mutually agreed upon and executed by Client and Service Provider detailing the necessary scope modification and, if applicable, revisions to the Service Provider resources, associated fees, and like changes.

Travel is not expected to be required for this engagement; provided, however, that any required pre-approved travel and out-of-pocket expenses shall be billed in addition to fees and paid by Client in accordance with the Agreement.
clauses.CATCH_ALL_EXCLUSION: Any services not explicitly set forth in this SOW are deemed out of scope for this SOW, and will be performed pursuant to a separate statement of work or change order executed by the parties.
clauses.LOCATION_OF_SERVICES: Work pursuant to this SOW will be performed remotely from Service Provider corporate and home offices.
clauses.DEFECT_SEVERITY_INTRO: Defects found in SIT or UAT are classified by severity. Service Provider commits to resolving in-scope Severity-1 defects before UAT sign-off; Severity-2 defects are resolved before sign-off where practical, but an open Severity-2 defect does not automatically block go-live; Severity-3 and Severity-4 defects are logged, dispositioned with the Client, and resolved during hypercare or deferred by mutual agreement.
clauses.DEFECT_GONOGO: Whether a defect blocks go-live is a Go/No-Go decision Service Provider and the Client make together, weighing the cost of the open defect against the cost of delaying go-live: the count of open Severity-2 defects, the soundness of any workaround, and the impact if the workaround is not followed. Open Severity-2 defects carried into go-live are documented with their workarounds and resolved during hypercare.
clauses.DEEMED_ACCEPTANCE: Client will accept completed Deliverables (as outlined in the sections of this SOW), if they materially conform to the specifications set forth in this SOW and Service Provider has submitted the deliverable for review to the Client according to the Project Plan. Should a completed Deliverable not materially conform to the specifications set forth in this SOW, Client will notify Service Provider of this non-conformance in reasonable detail within five (5) business days of delivery. Service Provider will have a reasonable period of time, based on the severity and complexity of the non-conformance, to correct the non-conformance. If Client fails to promptly notify Service Provider of any material non-conformance within five (5) business days after completed delivery, or unreasonable delays, then the completed Deliverable will be considered accepted by Client no later than the five (5) business days after delivery.
clauses.TM_CLOSE: The Professional Services described in this SOW are provided on a Time and Materials basis. We will bill on an hourly basis based on the actual hours worked in accordance with the hourly rates set forth herein, which may be subject to adjustment from time to time. The aggregate service fees for completion of the entire work set forth in this SOW are {TOTAL}. Any work outside the scope of this SOW shall be set forth in a separate statement of work.
clauses.TM_UPFRONT: All Fees and expenses will be invoiced and shall be due and payable in accordance with the terms of the Agreement. Upon SOW execution, an upfront invoice of {UPFRONT_PERCENT}% ({UPFRONT}) of the Total Estimated Fees will be submitted and payable in accordance with the terms of the Agreement. This upfront payment will be credited against the corresponding number of billable hours and netted against the final invoice(s).
clauses.FIXED_CLOSE: As compensation for providing the Services hereunder, you will pay us a fixed fee of {TOTAL} plus out of pocket expenses. These fees are based on the assumptions provided under this SOW. Service Provider is not obligated to perform any services related to assumptions unknown at the time of execution of this engagement or deemed to be outside the scope of this engagement. Service Provider will provide the consultants with roles identified in the Service Provider Roles and Responsibilities table above to perform the Services as outlined in this SOW.
clauses.FIXED_INVOICES: All invoices shall be due and payable in accordance with the terms of the Agreement.
clauses.EXPENSES_CARVEOUT: Actual, reasonable travel and out-of-pocket expenses in accordance with the Customer’s expense policies and state sales tax, if any, are not included in the Fees and will be invoiced separately, in accordance with the Agreement.
clauses.REMITTANCE_BILLTO_LABEL: We understand that our bills should be sent to:
REMITTANCE_CHECK: Use the payment instructions supplied with the confirmed contract profile.
REMITTANCE_ELECTRONIC: No bank details are included in this synthetic example.

MISC_TERMS.title: Order of Precedence.
MISC_TERMS.body: In the event of any conflict, inconsistency, or ambiguity between the terms of this SOW and the terms of the Agreement, this SOW shall control solely as to the specific Services, Deliverables, fees, assumptions, milestones, and schedules described herein, and the Agreement shall control in all other respects, including, without limitation, payment rights, intellectual property, confidentiality, warranties, indemnities, limitations of liability, dispute resolution, and general legal terms.

MISC_TERMS.title: Limited Modification.
MISC_TERMS.body: Except as expressly set forth in this SOW, this SOW does not amend, waive, or modify the Agreement. All terms of the Agreement not expressly modified by this SOW remain unchanged and in full force and effect.

MISC_TERMS.title: Project Assumptions.
MISC_TERMS.body: Service Provider’s performance schedule, pricing, staffing, and deliverables under this SOW are based on the assumptions, dependencies, and Client responsibilities described herein. Any material change to such assumptions, scope, timing, or Client responsibilities may require an equitable adjustment to fees, resources, milestones, and delivery dates through a written change order executed by the parties.

MISC_TERMS.title: Delays; Rescheduling; Resource Reallocation.
MISC_TERMS.body: Any delay caused by Client, including failure to timely provide dependencies, approvals, information, access, feedback, or required resources, shall automatically extend applicable schedules and milestone dates on a day-for-day basis, together with such additional time as reasonably necessary for remobilization and scheduling. If Client delays the project for more than ten (10) business days, Service Provider may reassign reserved personnel to other matters and reschedule Services subject to resource availability. Client-caused delays may result in additional fees, standby charges, rescheduling fees, or rate adjustments at Service Provider’s then-current rates.

clauses.SIGNATURE_PREAMBLE: Please indicate your agreement with these terms by signing and returning this SOW on or before {DATE} to enable the Service Provider to manage our resources and business. These terms are not valid if the Service Provider doesn’t receive this signed SOW by such date. This SOW may be executed in one or more counterparts and/or by facsimile or electronic submission, each of which will be deemed an original and all of which signed counterparts, taken together, will constitute one instrument. Service Provider looks forward to working with you on this important project.
clauses.AUTHORITY_BIND: Each person signing this document represents that he/she intends to and has the authority to bind his/her respective Party to this Statement of Work.
clauses.LOE_FIXED_CLOSE: The fixed fee for the services described in this letter is {TOTAL}, plus expenses expressly permitted by this letter and the Agreement. Work outside the stated scope requires a separately agreed change.
